login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to the control plane.
login.lockedOut: Too many attempts. Try again in a moment.

invite.title: Accept your invitation
invite.subtitle: Choose a password to activate your account.
invite.weakPassword: Choose a password of at least 8 characters.
invite.invalid: This invitation link is not valid. It may have expired or already been used — ask your administrator for a new invitation.
invite.missingToken: This invitation link is incomplete. Open the link exactly as it appears in your invitation email.
invite.success: Your account is active. Sign in with your new password.

setup.title: First-boot setup
setup.subtitle: No administrator exists yet. Create the first one with the one-time setup token printed in the server logs.
setup.tokenHint: Shown once on first boot, on the server's standard output.
setup.done: Administrator created. Sign in to continue.
setup.invalidToken: That setup token is not valid.

firstRun.createDescription: The control plane has no organization yet, and everything in the console belongs to one. Create it here — its default workspace and its audit ledger are provisioned with it.
firstRun.name: Organization name
firstRun.chooseDescription: Your account administers more than one organization. Pick the one to work in — you can switch at any time from the top bar.
firstRun.unavailableDescription: The control plane did not answer, so the console cannot tell whether an organization exists. Nothing was created.

session.expired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.

tenant.label: Organization
tenant.noneHint: Your account is not a member of any organization yet.
